# Rule Detectors

Generated by `python -m segfacet.rule_table` from each registered rule's `mode_declaration` and the bundled `default_config.yaml`. Do not edit by hand.

| Rule | Detector | Question | Reads | Fires when | Default | Modes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `border` | `expected_end` | Does a label touch only the cranio-caudal image face at the end of the present span where the FOV expects it to? | `per_label.{label}.geometry.touches_anterior`, `per_label.{label}.geometry.touches_inferior`, `per_label.{label}.geometry.touches_left`, `per_label.{label}.geometry.touches_posterior`, `per_label.{label}.geometry.touches_right`, `per_label.{label}.geometry.touches_superior` | only when `report_expected_ends` is true: a label touches no in-plane face, and each cranio-caudal face it touches is at its span end (finding severity is `end_severity`) | `report_expected_ends` = false | none |
| `border` | `unexpected_clip` | Is a label clipped by the image border in a way the FOV does not explain? | `per_label.{label}.geometry.touches_anterior`, `per_label.{label}.geometry.touches_inferior`, `per_label.{label}.geometry.touches_left`, `per_label.{label}.geometry.touches_posterior`, `per_label.{label}.geometry.touches_right`, `per_label.{label}.geometry.touches_superior` | a label touches any image face and is not an expected end: it touches an in-plane face (left, right, anterior, posterior), or a cranio-caudal face on a label that is not the span end at that side | (none) | none |
| `bounds` | `metric_out_of_range` | Is a label's volume or x/y/z extent outside the plausible [min, max] range for its level? | `per_label.{label}.geometry.extent_x_mm`, `per_label.{label}.geometry.extent_y_mm`, `per_label.{label}.geometry.extent_z_mm`, `per_label.{label}.geometry.physical_volume_mm3` | per metric (volume, extent_x, extent_y, extent_z): value < min or value > max, strictly; min/max are the level's reference percentiles when `source` is `reference` and the level is covered, else the hand-set group bounds; labels with no cervical/thoracic/lumbar group are skipped | `source` = "reference"; `reference_lower_pct` = 1; `reference_upper_pct` = 99; `reference_stratum` = "all" | 2, 3, 4 |
| `coverage` | `count_shortfall` | Are fewer levels present than the configured expected minimum count? | `relationships.present_levels[]` | `expected_count` is set and the number of present levels < `expected_count`, strictly (not border-aware) | `expected_count` = null | 10 |
| `coverage` | `incomplete_span` | Is an expected level absent just beyond either end of the present span, where the FOV should have covered it? | `relationships.present_levels[]` | an `expected_levels` entry is absent and ranks beyond a span end; with `border_aware`, only the single adjacent level beyond a non-truncated end counts, and nothing beyond a truncated end | `expected_levels` = []; `border_aware` = true | 10 |
| `coverage` | `missing_interior` | Is a level missing from inside the observed span of present levels? | `relationships.missing_levels[]` | `relationships.missing_levels` is non-empty (always active, never border-suppressed) | (none) | 10 |
| `fragmentation` | `components` | Is one label's largest connected component too small a share of the label to be a single body? | `per_label.{label}.components.component_count`, `per_label.{label}.components.component_sizes[]`, `per_label.{label}.components.fragmentation_index`, `per_label.{label}.components.largest_component_fraction` | `fragmentation_index` (else `largest_component_fraction`) < the threshold, strictly: the level's reference `largest_component_fraction` lower percentile when `source` is `reference` and the level is covered, else `fragmentation_index_threshold` | `fragmentation_index_threshold` = 0.75; `source` = "reference"; `reference_lower_pct` = 1; `reference_stratum` = "all" | 1 |
| `fragmentation` | `islands` | Does a label carry small disconnected pieces beside its dominant body, or more components than its level normally has? | `per_label.{label}.components.component_count`, `per_label.{label}.components.component_sizes[]`, `per_label.{label}.components.fragmentation_index`, `per_label.{label}.components.largest_component_fraction`, `per_label.{label}.components.stray_component_sizes[]` | when the level's reference covers `component_count`: `component_count` > that stat's upper percentile (replaces the voxel floor). Otherwise (no reference, or the level is covered only for `largest_component_fraction`): any stray component size < `island_min_voxels`, strictly | `island_min_voxels` = 50; `source` = "reference"; `reference_upper_pct` = 99; `reference_stratum` = "all" | 4 |
| `intensity` | `degenerate` | Is the label's intensity so uniform that it cannot be real bone? | `image_features.per_label.{label}.first_order.std` | `flag_degenerate` and the label's `first_order.std` <= `max_degenerate_std` (inclusive) | `flag_degenerate` = true; `max_degenerate_std` = 1.0 | 16 |
| `intensity` | `too_high` | Is the label's median HU above the plausible bone band (metal or implant)? | `image_features.per_label.{label}.first_order.median` | `flag_high` and the label's `first_order.median` > `max_plausible_hu`, strictly | `flag_high` = true; `max_plausible_hu` = 2000.0 | 16 |
| `intensity` | `too_low` | Is the label's median HU below the plausible bone band (soft tissue or air)? | `image_features.per_label.{label}.first_order.median` | `flag_low` and the label's `first_order.median` < `min_plausible_hu`, strictly | `flag_low` = true; `min_plausible_hu` = 100.0 | 16 |
| `intensity_reference_delta` | `distance` | Is the label's overall intensity profile far from its level's cohort intensity reference distribution? | (none declared) | `flag_distribution_distance` and the label's `distribution_distance` >= `max_distribution_distance` (inclusive), on a label the intensity reference covers | `flag_distribution_distance` = true; `max_distribution_distance` = 3.0 | none |
| `intensity_reference_delta` | `out_of_range` | Does an intensity feature of the label fall outside its level's reference percentile band? | (none declared) | `flag_out_of_range` and the feature is listed in the label's `out_of_range_features`, on a label the intensity reference covers; one finding per listed feature | `flag_out_of_range` = true | none |
| `intensity_reference_delta` | `robust_z` | Is an intensity feature of the label many robust standard deviations from its level's reference median? | (none declared) | `flag_robust_z` and \|`robust_z`\| >= `max_robust_z` (inclusive) for a feature, on a label the intensity reference covers; one finding per feature | `flag_robust_z` = true; `max_robust_z` = 3.5 | none |
| `mislabel` | `ordering` | Do two labels sit in the wrong order along the fitted spine curve? | `stage3.monotonic_consistency.non_monotonic_pairs[]` | `flag_order_inconsistency` and `stage3.monotonic_consistency.non_monotonic_pairs` lists a level pair; one finding per pair | `flag_order_inconsistency` = true | 9 |
| `neighbour_contact` | `stray_contact` | Does a stray component of this label press against a neighbouring label over a large share of its own surface? | `per_label.{label}.components.component_contacts[].contact_fraction` | `contact_fraction` > `contact_fraction_threshold`, strictly, per stray component (never index 0, the largest component) | `contact_fraction_threshold` = 0.1 | 2 |
| `overlap` | `overlapping_segments` | Do two labels claim the same voxels? | `overlaps[].overlap_voxels` | a pair's `overlap_voxels` >= `min_overlap_voxels` (inclusive); one finding per pair | `min_overlap_voxels` = 1 | 15 |
| `reference_delta` | `distance` | Is the label's overall geometry far from its level's cohort reference distribution? | (none declared) | `flag_distribution_distance` and the label's `distribution_distance` >= `max_distribution_distance` (inclusive), on a label the reference covers | `flag_distribution_distance` = true; `max_distribution_distance` = 3.0 | none |
| `reference_delta` | `out_of_range` | Does a geometric feature of the label fall outside its level's reference percentile band? | (none declared) | `flag_out_of_range` and the feature is listed in the label's `out_of_range_features`, on a label the reference covers; one finding per listed feature | `flag_out_of_range` = true | none |
| `reference_delta` | `robust_z` | Is a geometric feature of the label many robust standard deviations from its level's reference median? | (none declared) | `flag_robust_z` and \|`robust_z`\| >= `max_robust_z` (inclusive) for a feature, on a label the reference covers; one finding per feature | `flag_robust_z` = true; `max_robust_z` = 3.5 | none |
| `sequence` | `shift` | Are one or more labels moved several places along the head-to-tail order of their levels? | `per_label.{label}.centroid.centroid_mm[]`, `per_label.{label}.level_name` | the rank permutation of the centroid-ordered levels has a cycle longer than two; names its most-displaced member(s) | (none) | 9 |
| `sequence` | `skip` | Is a level absent between two present levels of the expected sequence? | `per_label.{label}.level_name` | an expected level lies between the first and last present sequence elements and no present label carries it | (none) | 10 |
| `sequence` | `swap` | Are two labels exchanged in the head-to-tail order of their levels? | `per_label.{label}.centroid.centroid_mm[]`, `per_label.{label}.level_name` | the rank permutation of the centroid-ordered levels has a 2-cycle; names both members | (none) | 9 |
| `sequence` | `transitional` | Does the level numbering use a non-default section count the field of view does not corroborate? | `per_label.{label}.level_name` | a section count is unaccepted by the resolved reading, or a present level lies outside that reading's expected sequence (Cocc excepted), excluding levels already named by swap or shift | (none) | 11 |
| `spline_offset` | `spline_offset` | Does a vertebra's centroid sit far off the spinal curve fitted through its neighbours? | `stage3.per_label_offsets[].offset_mm` | a non-terminal label's `offset_mm` >= `max_offset_mm` (inclusive); terminal (sequence-first/last) labels are skipped | `max_offset_mm` = 13.0 | none |
